content.title: SIGNS YOUR BODY IS ACTUALLY BEGGING FOR {{THESE NUTRIENTS}}
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, feeling cold constantly, dry skin, and a puffy face.
**Vitamin K** – Bruising easily, slow-healing cuts, and unexplained bleeding gums.
**Potassium** – Muscle cramps at night, irregular heartbeat, and persistent fatigue.
**Vitamin A** – Trouble seeing in dim light, dry eyes, and frequent infections.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, vision problems, and numbness in hands or feet.
**Folate** – Constant tiredness, irritability, and a pale or sallow complexion.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, frequent colds, and a noticeably reduced sense of smell.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A few of these deserve a closer look. Low **iodine** slows your thyroid down because your body simply can't make enough thyroid hormone without it, which is why energy and metabolism take a hit. **Potassium** works closely with sodium to send electrical signals to your muscles and heart, so when levels drop, cramps and irregular heartbeats can follow. And **folate** is essential for making new red blood cells — without enough, your body struggles to carry oxygen efficiently, leaving you drained and pale. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours and check in with a doctor if something feels off.

At @smarthealthfix we focus on nutrition, common health issues, organ health, and small daily habits that actually move the needle. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
